selection: words of the vocabulary written in lowercase Cyrillic [а-яё]+ in the web text, at least 4 letters, and lowercase compounds [а-яё]+(-[а-яё]+)+; the rank is the word's line in the source

source.integrity: downloaded over TLS; the source publishes no checksum or signature for the file, so its SHA-256 was recorded at download and every derivation refuses any other file
source.license: CC BY-SA 3.0, as the source page states for the word vectors
source.license_note: the counts derived from these forms ship inside the orthotactic artifact; that an adaptation of CC BY-SA 3.0 material may be shared under a later version with the same license elements, and that CC BY-SA 4.0 is one-way compatible with the GNU GPL version 3 (creativecommons.org, compatible licenses), is a reading of the license texts that no lawyer has reviewed
source.trained_on: Common Crawl and Wikipedia (Grave et al., Learning Word Vectors for 157 Languages)

use: counted only into the channel of Russian that scores a token typed in Russian
